Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer failed to execute the core task of extracting the specific data (dinosaur name and nominator) from the visible Wikipedia page. After multiple turns (steps 4 onwards) where the page `Wikipedia:Featured articles promoted in 2016` was loaded and the "Promoted in November 2016" section was clearly visible in the viewport (as indicated by the link in the text), the agent simply repeated the action of typing the URL and displaying the same static screenshot without actually scrolling down to the November section, extracting the text, or identifying the dinosaur entry. This represents a failure to perform the instructed analysis ("Locate the section... List all entries... Identify which ones are about dinosaurs") despite having the necessary visual context to do so.
